text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"One day in February. I was visiting a 
shopping mall together with Cesario."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
We managed to get a mug, coasters... and 
even a cute scarf too, didn't we!
choice_data_list: It looked great on you!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thank you very much♪ Maybe I'll wrap 
it on starting tomorrow.
choice_data_list: 似合ってたよ！
choice_data_list_en: It looked great on you!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Umm... anything else to buy...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While checking the shopping list together, 
a sign for a "Valentine's Fair" suddenly 
caught my eye.
choice_data_list:
Come to think of it, what should I do 
about chocolates this year?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Ah... That's true. It's almost Valentine's 
Day, after all.
choice_data_list: そういえば、今年のチョコはどうしよう？
choice_data_list_en: Come to think of it, what should we do about chocolates this year?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
—It's a tough call this year. Whether to 
make it by hand, or pick out some 
delicious chocolates instead.
choice_data_list: That's true...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Every year, Cesario makes handmade 
Valentine's chocolates for the children at 
Club Illyria.
choice_data_list: そうだよね……
choice_data_list_en: You're right...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Lately, however, there has been a rapid 
influx of children joining the club, 
inspired by Cesario's success.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While it warmed her heart, she also 
worried whether she could make enough 
handmade chocolate for all those children.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
If possible, I would like to convey my 
feelings with something handmade, but... 
there is the matter of time, and quantity.
choice_data_list: Would it help a little if I pitched in?

If I help out, will it make things a bit 
easier for you?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
! The Trainer did...? Yes, of course. I'd 
be very grateful!
choice_data_list: 俺が手伝ったら、少しは楽になる？
私が手伝ったら、少しは楽になる？
choice_data_list_en: Would it make things a little easier if I helped?
Would it make things a little easier if I helped?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...Yes!
choice_data_list: 一緒に手作りコーナーを覗いてみようよ
choice_data_list_en: Let's check out the handmade craft corner together!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In a special section of the mall, as the 
two of us checked out the "Handmade 
Chocolate Fair," a truffle-making kit 
caught our eye.
choice_data_list: I gave you truffles last year, remember?
I gave you truffles last year, didn't I?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It's surprisingly easy. You can 
create plenty of variations with the 
chocolate fillings and coatings, too.
choice_data_list: 去年はトリュフをあげたんだよね
去年はトリュフをあげたよね
choice_data_list_en: I gave you truffles last year, didn't I?
I gave you truffles last year, right?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"The only problem is the sheer quantity 
this year... There's barely any fridge 
space left to chill the chocolate."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I see, with this much chocolate, 
refrigerator space becomes an issue. That 
was a blind spot. Which means...
choice_data_list:
Something that doesn't need to be 
chilled... like baked goods?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
! That's true—baked sweets would be 
perfect!
choice_data_list: 冷やす必要がない……焼き菓子とか？
choice_data_list_en: Something that doesn't need to be kept cold... like baked goods?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
For example, with a pound cake, you can 
bake it all at once and slice it up for 
everyone.
choice_data_list:
Do you think I could make a chocolate 
pound cake?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Yes... But if we want to make it feel even 
more like Valentine's Day...
choice_data_list: チョコのパウンドケーキなら作れそう？
choice_data_list_en: Think you could make a chocolate pound cake?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
If it's brownies, I can make enough for 
everyone in the club!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu. Besides... mixing things into the 
dough gives it a fun texture.
choice_data_list: ――確かに！それがいいね！
choice_data_list_en: âGood point! That sounds great!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Yes. A moist dough with a crispy 
texture... I'd say it's the perfect match.
choice_data_list: ナッツとか……チョコクランチとか！
choice_data_list_en: Like nuts... or chocolate crunch!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
And then... let's see. Since it's for the 
children, I'd like it to look fun as well.
choice_data_list: Shall we look for those ingredients too?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The two of us looked around the shop floor 
once more... and found coating chocolate 
and chocolate sprinkles.
choice_data_list: その材料も、探してみようか
choice_data_list_en: Shall we search for those materials, too?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
The kids at the club are always so 
delighted whenever I bring cute-shaped 
sweets.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Anime characters are especially popular, 
but... this time, I wanted kids who don't 
watch TV to be able to enjoy it too.
choice_data_list: Then how about shaping it like an animal?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I was thinking the same thing! 
...Animals... animals...
choice_data_list: だったら、動物の形にするとか？
choice_data_list_en: Then how about shaping it like an animal?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Actually... I baked lion bread for her 
before. And before that, rabbit cookies.
choice_data_list: ライオンとか、ウサギとか！
choice_data_list_en: Like a lion, or a rabbit!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I've been making sweets for a long time, 
you see. So each time, I rack my brain 
wondering what to make. Fufufu.
choice_data_list: (Such fun hardships...!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Together with Cesario, I thought about it 
for a moment. When it comes to chocolate 
sprinkles... they're small, spiky—
choice_data_list: （そんなに楽しい苦労が……！）
choice_data_list_en: (Such enjoyable hardships...!)

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ! —That's it, a hedgehog!
choice_data_list: ……針みたい？……針……ハリネズミ？
choice_data_list_en: ...Like needles? ...Needles... a hedgehog?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Take a small, round castella cake, add 
sprinkles for the quills, and... our 
hedgehog is complete!
choice_data_list:
Amazing! They're definitely going to love 
it!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Yes, definitely! Once I get back to the 
academy, I'll make it right away.
choice_data_list: すごい！絶対に喜んでくれるね！
choice_data_list_en: Amazing! They're definitely going to love it!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ~♪ ~♪ When I open up~ the oven~♪

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Yes! They're chocolate brownies with nuts♪
choice_data_list: Oh! It turned out so moist!
Wah! It turned out so moist and tender!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... It's grilled to absolute 
perfection.
choice_data_list: おお！しっとり仕上がってる！
わあ！しっとり仕上がってるね！
choice_data_list_en: Oh! It turned out so moist!
Whoa! It turned out so moist!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"While it's cooling down, let's make the 
hedgehog chocolates."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
First, melt the chocolate for the 
coating...
choice_data_list:
The castella and chocolate sprinkles for 
the body go here.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
All ready, aren't we? Now then... slowly 
pour a thin layer of chocolate over the 
round castella cake—
choice_data_list: ボディのカステラとチョコスプレーはここに
choice_data_list_en: The sponge cake for the body and chocolate sprinkles go here.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
W-Wow, you're really good at this! The 
face part was left so neat and round.
choice_data_list: 背中にチョコスプレーを、パラパラっと
choice_data_list_en: Sprinkle some chocolate sprinkles on the back...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...Fufufu. Little hedgehog. I'm so glad 
they made you look so cute♪

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Yes! And with this, little hedgehog is 
complete.
choice_data_list:
Lined up like this, it's quite a 
spectacular sight!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, indeed. What a big hedgehog family. 
It looks like something out of a picture 
book.
choice_data_list: これだけたくさん並ぶと……壮観！
choice_data_list_en: With this many lined up... what a magnificent sight!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed... I can almost see the scene. So 
that's where you all were living♪"
choice_data_list: この季節だし、雪山に住んでるのかも
choice_data_list_en: Given the season, maybe it lives in the snowy mountains.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...—Ah! In that case...
choice_data_list: じゃあ、雪山も作れたら……なんて
choice_data_list_en: Then what if we built a snowy mountain too... just kidding.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
With coconut and silver dragées, let's 
turn this brownie into a snowy forest!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"I was taking a stroll in the forest— and 
ran into a tiny hedgehog! That's the 
scene♪"
choice_data_list:
That's amazing! They'll definitely love 
it!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, not at all. It was an idea the two 
of us came up with together.
choice_data_list: さすが！絶対に喜んでくれるよ！
choice_data_list_en: Brilliant! They're definitely going to love it!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
With this, I'm sure— the children's smiles 
will be doubled, too♪

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. The wrapping for the very last one 
is all finished.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having finished making the chocolates for 
the kids, I started counting them just to 
be sure...
choice_data_list: Huh? ...Is there one too many?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
No, that's the exact right amount. I just 
made one extra.
choice_data_list: あれ？……1個多い？
choice_data_list_en: Huh? ...Is there an extra one?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: That's—because it's for you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Go ahead, open it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Valentine's brownies from Cesario. Opening 
the bag—the hedgehog wasn't the only one 
standing in the forest.
choice_data_list: This tree... could it be an oak tree?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Spot on! âª It's a sugar confection oak 
tree.
choice_data_list: この木……もしかして、樫の木？
choice_data_list_en: This tree... could it be an oak?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
The oak tree we aimed for together—the 
Yushun Himba (Oaks). Even amid the snow, 
those memories remain vivid.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: —Happy Valentine's Day♪ Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. The wrapping for the very last one 
is all finished.
choice_data_list: Good work!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Cesario smiled after finishing the 
brownies for the children. ...However, she 
then began setting out plates next.
choice_data_list: お疲れ様！
choice_data_list_en: Good work!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: No. I have already finished making it.
choice_data_list: あれ？まだ作るものあったっけ……？
choice_data_list_en: Huh? Was there still something else to make...?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
A plate, some black tea... Fufu. Well 
then, Trainer, please take a seat.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What Cesario brought over was— a brownie 
that, while slightly smaller than before, 
was dense and rich.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
This has a bit of a kick to it... a flavor 
for adults.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I baked some coffee brownies. Just enough 
for the two of us, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Here you go, bon appétit♪
choice_data_list: Thank you!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The bittersweet experiences bring out the 
sweet, wonderful memories. The brownie 
tastes like a condensed journey of the two 
of them—
choice_data_list: ありがとう！！
choice_data_list_en: Thank you!!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Fufu. Fufufu.
choice_data_list: おいしい……すごくおいしいよ！
choice_data_list_en: Delicious... It's so good!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
No matter what, I just really wanted to 
see that smile.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: —Happy Valentine's Day♪ Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having finished making chocolate—it was 
now night. The two of them quietly sipped 
from their teacups. It was a time warmer 
and more peaceful than anywhere else in 
the world.
